mapper.select:
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, '1970-01-01 00:00:00', submission_submit_time) DIV 15 AS slot, COUNT(*) AS submissions FROM `voj_submissions` WHERE submission_submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submission_submit_time < #{endTime}
AND uid = #{uid} AND problem_id IN ( SELECT problem_id FROM voj_problems WHERE problem_status = 'PUBLISHED' )
AND submission_judge_result = 'AC'
GROUP BY slot

SELECT submission_judge_result AS slug, COUNT(*) AS submissions FROM `voj_submissions` WHERE submission_submit_time >= #{startTime} AND submission_submit_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY submission_judge_result
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voj_submissions WHERE submission_judge_result = 'PD'
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(submission_id), 0) FROM voj_submissions
SELECT s.submission_code, WHERE s.submission_id = #{submissionId}
SELECT WHERE s.submission_id = #{submissionId}

SELECT s.problem_id AS problemId, IF(problems.is_accepted, 'AC', s.submission_judge_result) AS judgeResult FROM ( SELECT problem_id, MAX(submission_id) AS latest_submission_id, MAX(submission_judge_result = 'AC') AS is_accepted FROM voj_submissions WHERE uid = #{uid} AND problem_id IN #{problemId} GROUP BY problem_id ) problems JOIN voj_submissions s ON s.submission_id = problems.latest_submission_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.problem_id) FROM voj_submissions s JOIN voj_problems p ON p.problem_id = s.problem_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.submission_judge_result = 'AC' AND p.problem_status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voj_submissions s JOIN voj_problems p ON p.problem_id = s.problem_id WHERE s.uid = #{uid} AND s.submission_judge_result != 'PD' AND s.submission_judge_result != 'SE' AND p.problem_status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT d.problem_difficulty_slug AS slug, d.problem_difficulty_name AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.problem_status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN p.problem_id END) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.problem_status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.submission_judge_result = 'AC' THEN s.problem_id END) AS solved FROM voj_problem_difficulty d LEFT JOIN voj_problems p ON p.problem_difficulty_id = d.problem_difficulty_id LEFT JOIN voj_submissions s ON s.problem_id = p.problem_id AND s.uid = #{uid}
GROUP BY d.problem_difficulty_id, d.problem_difficulty_slug, d.problem_difficulty_name ORDER BY d.problem_difficulty_id
SELECT uid AS uid, COUNT(DISTINCT problem_id) AS solved FROM voj_submissions WHERE submission_judge_result = 'AC' GROUP BY uid ORDER BY solved DESC, uid ASC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT problem_id) FROM voj_submissions WHERE uid = #{uid} AND submission_judge_result = 'AC'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT uid FROM voj_submissions WHERE submission_judge_result = 'AC' GROUP BY uid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT problem_id) > #{numberOfSolvedProblems} ) users_ahead
